value.rationale: Mutually commuting idempotents are the compatible algebra retractions, a structural invariant not inferable from their individual count or automorphism group. The theorem gives a complete graph-and-clique classification for every odd prime power, a sharp square-class boundary, exact maximal compatible systems and a probability spectrum. The natural smallest three-dimensional non-Lie symmetric class-two family is motivated by the existing automorphism classification; no arbitrary isolated parameter is selected.
